prerequisites: Nia is at the library
actions: Lio notices Nia’s worry
consequences: The search begins with Nia’s need, not a mysterious object appearing
prose_obligations: Establish closing time and Lio’s own wish to collect a reserved comic

prerequisites: Nia has lost her library loan
actions: Nia names The Moon in My Pocket and describes the silver moon
consequences: The target and borrower are clear
prose_obligations: Keep Nia’s distress ordinary and specific

prerequisites: Lio understands the deadline
actions: Lio promises to search before closing
consequences: Later endings distinguish a kept promise from an honest failure
prose_obligations: Make the promise voluntary, not a rule recited by a narrator

prerequisites: Lio asks Ms Vale
actions: Ms Vale permits a slow, supervised trolley loan
consequences: The trolley’s owner, location, and usefulness are tracked
prose_obligations: Return the trolley and show what it helped them do

prerequisites: The trolley is loaned
actions: Move a small stack of returns out of the doorway
consequences: The aisle clears and the trolley is useful even if it does not contain the missing book
prose_obligations: Do not treat borrowed custody as the trolley’s only payoff

prerequisites: The title is known
actions: Check the catalogue entry
consequences: The current catalogue gives the true spot; the stale one points to the low shelf
prose_obligations: Let the catalogue be a clue, not magical certainty

prerequisites: The catalogue may be stale
actions: Notice the entry date and distinguish an old location from a current one
consequences: An inaccurate catalogue can waste time and change ladder access
prose_obligations: Explain why the information is outdated

prerequisites: Lio asks the librarian or finds the desk unattended
actions: Check the reshelving note; confirm whether staff and a safe ladder are available
consequences: Staff can give a location hint and supervise a stable ladder; absence or instability can make a high shelf unreachable
prose_obligations: Never let a child climb an unsafe ladder alone

prerequisites: The trolley is with Lio; the library is open
actions: Sort the returned books carefully
consequences: A book misplaced among returns can be found; a squeaky wheel costs time
prose_obligations: Use the trolley as a working surface and keep the books’ locations continuous

prerequisites: A catalogue, staff, or shelf-label clue makes the search reasonable
actions: Check the low shelves
consequences: A low-shelf book can be retrieved; a false lead costs time
prose_obligations: A wrong search should have a legible reason

prerequisites: The children have checked the catalogue
actions: Talk about Nia’s last reading spot and check beneath the cushion if still searching
consequences: The book may be found there; otherwise Nia’s memory still shapes the search
prose_obligations: If the book was already found or the library closed, do not claim a new discovery

prerequisites: Nia can show her paper bookmark
actions: Share the moon drawing and let Lio hold the bookmark
consequences: Trust persists across scenes; on success the bookmark can be returned inside the recovered book
prose_obligations: Do not mention a bookmark in routes that omit this encounter

prerequisites: The children are still inside
actions: Nia explains how she reads the picture labels on book spines
consequences: Her knowledge can unlock a later low-shelf search
prose_obligations: Give Nia competence rather than making her a passive parcel

prerequisites: Lio has made room for Nia to help
actions: Nia takes the list and chooses how to assist
consequences: Their trust and later teamwork reflect the interaction
prose_obligations: Make the change small and earned

prerequisites: The high shelf is a plausible lead; a staff member must be available
actions: Ms Vale checks the step ladder and supervises
consequences: Only a stable, supervised ladder makes the upper-shelf action possible
prose_obligations: Do not let urgency excuse unsafe climbing

prerequisites: A stable ladder, staff supervision, and a top-shelf clue
actions: Search only the shelf Ms Vale directs
consequences: A book there can be moved onto the trolley before closing
prose_obligations: Show the physical retrieval and the time risk

scenes.location: returns, low shelf, window, or upper shelf
prerequisites: The chosen search matches the book’s actual spot and finishes before closing
actions: Move the one physical book from its spot to the trolley
consequences: Only an enacted search can set book.found
prose_obligations: Never reveal a book through an omitted scene

prerequisites: The bookmark vignette occurred
actions: Put the borrowed bookmark into the recovered book, or return it to Nia after an unsuccessful search
consequences: Bookmark custody remains consistent in either ending
prose_obligations: Only include the callback when the bookmark was shared

prerequisites: The borrowed trolley has been used
actions: Return the trolley to its bay after sorting and carrying books
consequences: Owner and location return to the library in both endings
prose_obligations: Return its usefulness, not merely its custody

prerequisites: A book was found in time, or all accessible searches are exhausted / the library closes
actions: Give Nia her recovered book, or tell her the truth and let her choose a substitute
consequences: The promise has a concrete kept or not-kept outcome; both endings complete the friendship beat
prose_obligations: No empty future-plan ending and no claim that a missing book was found

consolidation_note: Twenty reference encounters are a narrative inventory, not twenty executable scenes. Opening, promise, trolley permission, and aisle clearing are one local play. Catalogue lookup and its stale-entry complication are one scene with parameter-sensitive prose. Ladder safety is resolved within the librarian encounter, while the actual search is a separate guarded scene. Discovery is an action inside the matching search, not a free-standing scene. Handoff, bookmark return, trolley return, and resolution are combined in the two ending scenes. The implemented_ids union exactly matches world.SCENES.
